jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Scenic Route
seedTermsUsed: A fear or phobia rearing its head
jokes.joke: My fear of getting lost only shows up on country roads. GPS says, “Turn left in 800 feet,” and every left looks like a driveway where a man named Earl owns three dogs and a shovel. I don’t miss turns anymore; I just keep driving until the road becomes an interstate or Canada.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Ring
seedTermsUsed: A fear or phobia rearing its head
jokes.joke: My girlfriend's a jewelry designer, so when she got down on one knee in the kitchen and pulled out a little box, I panicked and yelled 'I'm not ready!' Turns out she just dropped a earring backing. She was picking it up off the floor. Now she can't kneel down anywhere near me without me screaming like I've seen a ghost.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Country Drive
seedTermsUsed: A fear or phobia rearing its head
jokes.joke: City people romanticize driving down a dark country road until their headlights hit an antique rocking chair sitting in an empty field. You don’t even need to believe in ghosts. Every buried childhood fear comes right back. My GPS said, 'In half a mile, turn around,' and my engine wasn’t even off yet. That’s not navigation; that’s the car agreeing we’re about to be murdered.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: For My Sister
jokes.joke: I'm a jewelry designer. When a guy walks into my shop asking for an engagement-sized diamond 'for his sister,' I get suspicious. Because either he's the world's best brother... or the world's worst liar.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Roadside Panic
seedTermsUsed: A fear or phobia rearing its head
jokes.joke: I was driving down this empty country road, feeling all peaceful, when my old childhood fear suddenly kicked in. Out of nowhere I thought, “If a squirrel jumps out right now, I’m swerving into retirement.” I don’t know why I panic at squirrels, but every time one twitches, I react like it’s trying to repossess my car.
